patterns.name: Go route handler calls database without input validation
patterns.description: A route-registering file's call graph reaches a database operation but no validation or sanitization function is found in the reachable call path. This is a heuristic check — medium confidence. The handler may be accepting user input without validating it before use in a SQL query or ORM call, creating an injection risk (OWASP A03).
patterns.message: Route handler in {file} calls database operations (e.g., {sink}) but no validation or sanitization function (Validate*, Sanitize*, Clean*, Escape*) was found in the call path. Medium confidence — verify that user input is validated before reaching the database layer.
